en: Color-tinted vintage harbor scene showing small naval ships or torpedo boats moored along a quay with sailors and civilians on board and on the pier. The calm water reflects the vessels, and additional piers and harbor structures extend into the distance on the right. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left, and there is cursive handwriting across the lower part of the image.
